mapper.select: SELECT A.*, B.portfolioShare FROM (SELECT D.FINPROD_ID AS assetId, A.FINPROD_NAME AS assetName, C.PORTFOLIO_ID AS portfolioId, C.PORTFOLIO_NAME AS portfolioName, IFNULL(A.FINPROD_TYPE2, E.FINPROD_TYPE2) as finprodType2, F.TYPE_9 AS type9, F.TYPE_10 AS type10, F.TYPE_11 AS type11, F.TYPE_12 AS type12, SUM(CASE WHEN A.FINPROD_TYPE2='F01' THEN IFNULL(D.SHARE_AMT, 0)*100 ELSE IFNULL(D.SHARE_AMT, 0) END ) AS shareAmt, SUM(IFNULL(D.DSC_COST_AMT, 0) + IFNULL(D.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL, 0)) AS netAssetValue FROM PTL_SEC_VALUTION D left JOIN FIN_PRODUCT A ON D.FINPROD_ID=A.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO C ON D.PORTFOLIO_ID= C.PORTFOLIO_ID AND DATE_FORMAT(D.CDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') = #{endDate} AND D.PORTFOLIO_ID=#{portfolioId} LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT E ON E.FINPROD_ID = D.FINPROD_ID AND E.BRANCH = 0 INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE F ON F.FINPROD_ID = D.FINPROD_ID GROUP BY D.FINPROD_ID, A.FINPROD_NAME , C.PORTFOLIO_ID , C.PORTFOLIO_NAME , IFNULL(A.FINPROD_TYPE2, E.FINPROD_TYPE2), F.TYPE_9, F.TYPE_10, F.TYPE_11, F.TYPE_12) A JOIN ( SELECT SUM(shareAmt ) AS portfolioShare,portfolioId FROM (SELECT D.FINPROD_ID AS assetId, A.FINPROD_NAME AS assetName, C.PORTFOLIO_ID AS portfolioId, C.PORTFOLIO_NAME AS portfolioName, IFNULL(A.FINPROD_TYPE2, E.FINPROD_TYPE2) as finprodType2, F.TYPE_9 AS type9, F.TYPE_10 AS type10, F.TYPE_11 AS type11, F.TYPE_12 AS type12, SUM(CASE WHEN A.FINPROD_TYPE2='F01' THEN IFNULL(D.SHARE_AMT, 0)*100 ELSE IFNULL(D.SHARE_AMT, 0) END ) AS shareAmt, SUM(IFNULL(D.DSC_COST_AMT, 0) + IFNULL(D.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL, 0)) AS netAssetValue FROM PTL_SEC_VALUTION D left JOIN FIN_PRODUCT A ON D.FINPROD_ID=A.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO C ON D.PORTFOLIO_ID= C.PORTFOLIO_ID AND DATE_FORMAT(D.CDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') = #{endDate} AND D.PORTFOLIO_ID=#{portfolioId} LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT E ON E.FINPROD_ID = D.FINPROD_ID AND E.BRANCH = 0 INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE F ON F.FINPROD_ID = D.FINPROD_ID GROUP BY D.FINPROD_ID, A.FINPROD_NAME , C.PORTFOLIO_ID , C.PORTFOLIO_NAME , IFNULL(A.FINPROD_TYPE2, E.FINPROD_TYPE2), F.TYPE_9, F.TYPE_10, F.TYPE_11, F.TYPE_12)h GROUP BY portfolioId ) B ON A.portfolioId=B.portfolioId

SELECT A.PORTFOLIO_ID ,A.PORTFOLIO_NAME ,D.FINPROD_ID ,0 as BRANCH ,C.FINPROD_TYPE2 ,C.PROFIT_TYPE ,C.VDATE ,B.DEAL_MODE ,STR_TO_DATE(#{startDate},'%Y-%m-%d') as startDate FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO A JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD B ON A.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID=B.PORTFOLIO_ID inner JOIN FIN_PRODUCT C ON B.FINPROD_ID=C.FINPROD_ID JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT(FINPROD_ID) FROM BOK_POSITION_PRD) D ON D.FINPROD_ID=A.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE 1=1
and A.PORTFOLIO_ID=#{portfolioId}

SELECT R1.portfolioId ,R3.PORTFOLIO_NAME AS portfolioName ,R1.finprodId ,R1.finprodName ,R1.assetCost AS bonds ,R1.assetNetVal ,R1.assetCost ,R2.ptlAssetNetVal ,R2.ptlAssetCost FROM (SELECT A.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId ,A.FINPROD_ID finprodId ,B.FINPROD_NAME finprodName ,IFNULL(A.DSC_COST_AMT,0)+IFNULL(A.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL,0) AS assetNetVal ,(CASE WHEN B.FINPROD_TYPE2='F01' THEN IFNULL(A.SHARE_AMT,0)*100 ELSE IFNULL(A.SHARE_AMT,0) END) AS assetCost FROM PTL_SEC_VALUTION A LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT B ON A.FINPROD_ID=B.FINPROD_ID WHERE A.PORTFOLIO_ID=#{portfolioId} AND A.CDATE=STR_TO_DATE(#{endDate},'%Y-%m-%d'))R1 JOIN (SELECT A.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, SUM(IFNULL(A.DSC_COST_AMT,0)+IFNULL(A.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL,0)) AS ptlAssetNetVal ,SUM((CASE WHEN B.FINPROD_TYPE2='F01' THEN IFNULL(A.SHARE_AMT,0)*100 ELSE IFNULL(A.SHARE_AMT,0) END)) AS ptlAssetCost FROM PTL_SEC_VALUTION A LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT B ON A.FINPROD_ID=B.FINPROD_ID GROUP BY A.PORTFOLIO_ID,A.CDATE HAVING A.PORTFOLIO_ID=#{portfolioId} AND A.CDATE=STR_TO_DATE(#{endDate},'%Y-%m-%d'))R2 ON R1.portfolioId=R2.portfolioId JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO R3 ON R1.portfolioId=R3.PORTFOLIO_ID

select * from (select PORTFOLIO_ID as id, PORTFOLIO_NAME as text from PTL_PORTFOLIO WHERE PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID IS NOT NULL
AND (DATE_FORMAT(VDATE,'%Y-%m-%d')>=#{startDate} and #{endDate}>=DATE_FORMAT(VDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') OR #{endDate}>=DATE_FORMAT(MDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(MDATE,'%Y-%m-%d')>=#{startDate})
)
id like CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search},'%')) or text like CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search},'%'))

SELECT * FROM (SELECT STRATEGY_ID AS id, STRATEGY_NAME AS text FROM PTL_INV_STRATEGY)
id like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) or text like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%'))
